q.line: Oh, but she loves like sleep to the freezing
stanza: Her fight and fury's fiery
Oh, but she loves like sleep to the freezing
Sweet and right and merciful, I'm all but washed
In the tide of her breathing

partner.line: In the tide of her breathing

q.line: My back is numb, my hands are freezing
stanza: And the day will come when I'll find a reason
And somebody proud to love a man like me
My back is numb, my hands are freezing
What I'm working for is something more than free

partner.line: And somebody proud to love a man like me

q.line: All the usual birds were gone or freezing
stanza: In the middle of November we went back into the woods right after breakfast to…
At the barricade, I stood listening
In my backpack you were sleeping with her hat pulled low
All the usual birds were gone or freezing
It was all silent except the sound of one crow following us as we wove through…
I walked and you bobbed and dozed, sweet kid
We were watched and followed and I thought of Geneviève
Sweet kid, I heard you murmur in your sleep
"Crow," you said
"Crow," and I asked
"Are you dreaming about a crow?"
And there she was

partner.line: Sweet kid, I heard you murmur in your sleep

q.line: You didn't talk for a while, you were freezing
stanza: When I was checking vitals, I suggested a smile
You didn't talk for a while, you were freezing
You said you hated my tone, it made you feel so alone
And so you told me I ought to be leaving
